translations.web: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to Yahweh your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”
translations.bsb: The king commanded all the people, “Keep the Passover of the LORD your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.”
translations.kjv: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.
translations.asv: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto Jehovah your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.
